content:
I just wanted to announce a small milestone: we have saturated the merge queue, and can no longer keep up with merging Tau Ceti PRs to main serially. :tada:

(edit: actually, mostly this is because of a bug in lake cache, that will be resolved any moment now when v4.34.0-rc1 is available. So we'll have to try harder to really saturate!)
Happily, we have good options here: I'm not planning on adopting Mathlib's bors solution, as I think Github merge queue technology is now good enough for our purposes.

Next challenge: saturate that too!

(At which point I will add private runners, instead of relying on the free Github actions runners. And probably work out how to speed up CI, there is some low hanging fruit there too.)
